content: In a test an examine either guesses or copies or knows the answer to a multiple choice question with four choices. The probability that he make a guess is <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.566ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="3.394ex" height="2.262ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -750 1500 1000" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mn"><use data-c="31" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-31"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(500,0)"><use data-c="2F" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2F"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(1000,0)"><use data-c="33" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-33"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> and the probability that he  copies the answer is <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.566ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="3.394ex" height="2.262ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -750 1500 1000" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mn"><use data-c="31" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-31"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(500,0)"><use data-c="2F" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2F"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(1000,0)"><use data-c="36" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-36"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>. The probability that his answer is correct given that he copied it, is <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.566ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="3.394ex" height="2.262ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -750 1500 1000" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mn"><use data-c="31" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-31"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(500,0)"><use data-c="2F" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2F"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(1000,0)"><use data-c="38" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-38"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>. Find the probability that he knew the answer to the questions given that he correctly answered it.
